name: dealflow360
description: DealFlow360 — Intelligent B2B Sales Operations Platform

scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset: cd server && npx prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.setup: npm run docker:up && sleep 5 && cd server && npm install && npx prisma migrate dev --name init && npx prisma db seed && cd ../client && npm install
